title: Grok Bot Reaches More Plans, and Now It Does the Jobs Agencies Sell
desc: xAI expanded Grok Bot, its always-on AI teammate, to more plans on August 26. Why the jobs it now handles turn it into a build-versus-buy call for SMBs.
keywords: grok bot, xai grok bot, ai teammate, always-on ai agent, ai sales agent, build vs buy ai automation
cta: Want automation built around your data, not a generic bot?
body:
August 28, 2026. On August 26, xAI, now part of SpaceX, expanded access to Grok Bot, its always-on AI teammate product, to every SuperGrok tier and to Cursor Pro and Cursor Teams plans. Grok Bot launched in beta on August 11. What makes this a business story rather than a model story is the jobs xAI lists these bots doing today: a sales prospector that researches accounts and drafts outreach, a support bot that handles routine refunds within policy, an office manager that works client portals, and an inbox manager. Those are the exact functions small teams pay agencies to automate, which turns the release into a build-versus-buy question for anyone selling done-for-you automation.

What xAI launched

  1. Grok Bot, in beta since August 11, is now included with all SuperGrok, SuperGrok Plus and SuperGrok Heavy tiers and with Cursor Pro, Cursor Pro+, Cursor Ultra and Cursor Teams plans.
  2. Each bot is an always-on cloud teammate with its own computer, browser and terminal access, that signs into your apps and does the work inside the real tool. You can run many at once and put them in a group chat to pass work between themselves.
  3. Bot usage is billed separately from the underlying Grok or Cursor plan, and an enterprise waitlist is open for larger rollouts.

The pattern worth copying

The detail operators should note is in xAI's own examples: the sales prospector leaves every send for you to approve, and the support bot only issues refunds within a set policy. That is a human gate on the irreversible actions, and it is the same lesson running through OpenAI's agent incident report from the same week. An always-on agent with browser access and live logins is powerful precisely because it can act, so the value is in scoping what it may do without asking. When you wire one into a lead generation flow, the approval step on outbound is not friction, it is what keeps your domain and sender reputation intact.

What it means for operators

General agent products will keep absorbing the simplest automations, so the SMB question is which work to hand to an off-the-shelf bot and which to build. Routine, low-risk jobs like sorting an inbox or drafting a first pass are fair game for a generic teammate. The revenue-critical flows, outbound that must stay compliant, a CRM that must not be corrupted, a checkout that must not break, are where a governed, purpose-built AI automation earns its keep. The tools are commoditizing; the judgment about where to trust them is not.
faqs: Grok Bot is xAI's always-on AI teammate. Each bot has its own cloud computer with browser and terminal access, signs into your apps, and completes work inside the actual tools. You message it like a colleague, can run several in parallel, and can teach it a routine by having it follow along once.

xAI expanded Grok Bot access from its August 11 beta to all SuperGrok tiers and to Cursor Pro, Cursor Pro+, Cursor Ultra and Cursor Teams plans. Grok Bot usage is billed separately from the underlying plan, and an enterprise waitlist is open.
Should my business use an off-the-shelf agent or build one?

Hand routine, low-risk work such as inbox sorting or first-draft writing to a general agent. Build a purpose-built, governed automation for revenue-critical flows like compliant outbound, CRM updates or checkout, where a mistake is expensive and the agent needs your data and rules.
How do I keep an always-on agent safe?

Keep a human approval step on anything hard to reverse, such as sends, payments or record changes, exactly as xAI's own examples do by leaving outreach for approval and capping refunds to policy. Scope its logins and log its actions so it can act quickly without acting dangerously.
